messages:
Dana: Thanks for the questions in todays all-hands. Dropping the compact follow-up for the reliability segment and RCA link.
Dana: RCA published -> https://docs.redwood.ai/rca/2026-03-incident-237. Read TL;DR + action list.
Mohan: Quick Q: are those action items prioritized? I want to align comping work.
Dana: Yes  P0/P1 tags inside the RCA. P0 = router misroute + fallback; P1 = observability and autoscaler tuning.
Elena: Obs ask: who owns token-level breakdown for the fallback region?
Priya: Elena owns obs (RED-7123). Runtime (Rory) owns the hotfix; infra keeps the routing override until validation.
Rory: Confirming hotfix timeline: target 03/24 10:00 PT. Ill post PR link here when CI passes.
Sam: Verification plan: smoke script + 15m soak on staging, then canary. Smoke cmd: ./scripts/smoke-check --model gpt-redwood-v1 --concurrency 5
incident-bot: incident-237 status -> postmortem published: https://incidents.redwood.ai/237
Claire: Ill draft the customer email + status page update; will post drafts for review by 11:30 PT.
Dana: Short actions: 1) Runtime hotfix (Rory) 03/24 10:00 PT. 2) Routing override + rollback playbook (Priya) target 03/24 12:00 PT. 3) RED-7123 trace + histograms (Elena) triage by EOD. 4) Comms (Claire) draft 11:30 PT. 5) Post-deploy verify (Mohan+Sam) 30m signoff.
Mohan: Ill export sequence-length distribution and attach to RED-7123 by 09:00 PT.
Rory: PR will be linked in RCA when ready. If tests fail, Ill post rollback steps here.
Priya: If routing override needs >12h, infra requests a maintenance window; otherwise we aim to keep it <12h.
Sam: Ill run the smoke + soak and post p50/p95/p99 snapshots in this thread.
Dana: Please mark the RCA checklist items you own (so execs can review). If you cant meet targets, flag now.
Elena: RED-7123 updated with sample traces and a short dev checklist.
Claire: Drafts posted -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/237-draft. Posting for review now.
Dana: Thanks all. Ill summarize the final actions at 11:45 PT and close this follow-up unless objections.
Mohan: No objections.
incident-bot: Reminder: status page update due in 1 hour for incident-237.
